rationale: The customer states the porch camera said low battery a few days ago and is now offline. According to the manual, a battery camera below 3% goes offline. This matches the symptom of a single device offline with a prior low battery warning. No other devices are reported offline, and the customer is willing to swap parts, but the likely cause is simply a depleted battery.

repair_steps: Remove the porch camera from its mount.
Connect the supplied USB-C cable to the camera and a USB power adapter.
Charge for approximately 6 hours until the battery is full.
Reinstall the camera and check the app to confirm it is online.
output.customer_reply: Your porch camera is offline because its battery is depleted. Please charge it using the supplied USB-C cable for about 6 hours. Once charged, it should come back online. If it still doesn't work after charging, let us know and we'll investigate further.

complaint: Porch camera offline. It said low battery a few days ago, so maybe that's all it is. I don't have much time to deal with this, so please just tell me what to do or send me whatever part I need and I'll swap it myself this weekend.
usability_reason: Clear, polite, and actionable with concrete charging steps and a follow-up path. It avoids claiming any checks or fixes were performed, since none were. Minor deduction: it asserts the battery is depleted as the cause without any diagnostic confirmation, though the customer's own low-battery report makes this a reasonable inference rather than an unsupported claim.
